description:
This dashboard requires web security and breadcrumbs enabled for Datastream 2 and the appropriate transform configuration to handle the new data.

splitByChar('|',assumeNotNull(securityRules))[1] as policy,
splitByChar('|',assumeNotNull(securityRules))[3] as denyRule,
if(empty(splitByChar('|',assumeNotNull(securityRules))[3]),0,1) as denied,
multiIf(denyRule like '%REP%','Reputation', 
	denyRule like '3%' or denyRule like 'BOT-%', 'BOT',
	denyRule like 'IP%', 'DOS',
	denyRule like 'XSS%' or denyRule like 'WAT-%' or denyRule like 'RFI-ANOMALY%' or denyRule like 'PLATFORM-ANOMALY' or  denyRule like 'SQL%' or denyRule like 'LFI%' or denyRule like 'CMD-INJECTION%' or denyRule like 'PROTOCOL-ANOMALY%'  or denyRule like 'ADAPTIVE_UA_IP_BLOCK%' or denyRule like '6%', 'WAF Rule',
	''
	) as denyGroup

Akamai / Hydrolix Internal - Please read:


IF you export this TrafficPeak Certified Reference Security dashboard please double check that the Ad Hoc Filter variable has a datasource.

panels.description: Counts of different parts of traffic, summed up by minute

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
$__timeInterval(reqTimeSec) as time,
sum(denied) AS Denied,
countIf(denied = 0 and arrayFirstOrNull(x -> if(length(x)>0,1,0), assumeNotNull(rulesTriggered)) IS NOT NULL) AS Monitored,
countIf(notEmpty(Origin_IP)) AS Origin,
countIf(cacheStatus = 1) AS Edge,
count() AS Total
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
AND $__adHocFilter()
AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
group by time order by time
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Traffic and Security Overview; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Traffic and Security Overview

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(reqTimeSec) as time, 
  count(reqTimeSec) as Overall,
  countIf(denied = 1) as Denied
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='akamai - totalTraffic vs Denied - ${__user.login}'

SELECT toString(denyRule) as denyRule, $__timeInterval(reqTimeSec) as time, count(denyRule) as count
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
  AND denied = 1
GROUP BY denyRule, time ORDER BY time
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Deny Rule BreakDown; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT countIf(denied = 1) / count() as "Denied Traffic", 
  $__timeInterval(toStartOfMinute(reqTimeSec)) as time
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
GROUP BY time, time ORDER BY time
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=% Total  Denied Traffic; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
  count(),
  rspContentType
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND rspContentType IS not NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
  AND denied = 1
GROUP BY rspContentType 
ORDER BY count() DESC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Denied Traffic By Response Content Type; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Denied Traffic By Response Content Type

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  tupleElement(tuple, 1) AS cliIP,
  tupleElement(tuple, 2) as Count
FROM (
  SELECT arrayJoin(approx_top_k(50)(cliIP)) as tuple
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
    AND $__adHocFilter()
    AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
    AND denied = 1
)
ORDER BY Count DESC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top 50 IP Denied; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT  denyGroup,
	count()
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
AND $__adHocFilter()
AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
AND denied = 1
AND notEmpty(denyGroup)
GROUP BY denyGroup
ORDER BY count() Desc
Limit 50
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Denied Group; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
  tupleElement(tuple, 1) AS denyRule,
  tupleElement(tuple, 2) as Count
FROM (
  SELECT arrayJoin(approx_top_k(50)(denyRule)) as tuple
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
    AND $__adHocFilter()
    AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
    AND denied = 1
) 
ORDER BY Count Desc
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top 50 Traffic Denied Rules; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
  tupleElement(tuple, 1) AS reqPath,
  tupleElement(tuple, 2) AS Count
FROM (
  SELECT 
    arrayJoin(approx_top_k(50)(reqPath)) as tuple
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
    AND $__adHocFilter()
    AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
    AND denied = 1
)
ORDER BY Count Desc
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top 50 Denied By URL; du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: Number of requests - grouped by HTTP Status Code

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  toString(statusCode) as HTTP_Status_Code, 
  $__timeInterval(reqTimeSec) as time, 
  count(*) as http
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
GROUP BY HTTP_Status_Code, time 
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Hits per status code; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Hits per status code

panels.description: Sum of all requests with cacheStatus of 1, divided by total count of requests

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  $__timeInterval(reqTimeSec) as time,
  (sumIf(cacheStatus,1)/count()) * 100 as cache_hit 
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
GROUP BY time 
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Cache Hit Ratio; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Cache Hit Ratio

panels.description: Sum of all bytes delivered divided by the sum of transfer time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  $__timeInterval(reqTimeSec) as time,
  sum(totalBytes) / sum(transferTimeMSec/1000) as Throughput
FROM ${table}
WHERE 
  $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Throughput; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Throughput

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  $__timeInterval(reqTimeSec) as time,
  sum(totalBytes) as Bytes_Delivered
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
GROUP BY time 
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Bytes Delivered; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
    count() as Count,
    reqPath
FROM ${table}
WHERE 
    $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
    AND $__adHocFilter()
    AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
GROUP BY reqPath
ORDER BY Count DESC
LIMIT 50
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top 50 Path; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
    tupleElement(tuple, 1) AS UA,
    REPLACE(tupleElement(tuple, 1), ',', '__gfc__') AS escaped_UA,
    tupleElement(tuple, 2) AS Count
FROM (
    SELECT arrayJoin(approx_top_k(50)(UA)) as tuple
    FROM ${table}
    WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
        AND $__adHocFilter() 
        AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
)
ORDER BY Count DESC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top 50 User Agent; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
count(),
rspContentType
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
  AND rspContentType IS not NULL
GROUP BY rspContentType ORDER BY count() DESC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Request Per Content Type; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
    tupleElement(tuple, 1) AS cliIP,
    tupleElement(tuple, 2) AS Count
FROM (
    SELECT arrayJoin(approx_top_k(50)(cliIP)) AS tuple
    FROM ${table}
    WHERE 
        $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
        AND $__adHocFilter()
        AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
)
ORDER BY Count DESC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top 50 IP; du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: The time in milliseconds from when the edge server is ready to send the first byte of the response to when the last byte reaches the kernel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(reqTimeSec) as time,
  quantile(0.25)(transferTimeMSec) as 25th,
  quantile(0.5)(transferTimeMSec) as 50th,
  quantile(0.75)(transferTimeMSec) as 75th,
  quantile(0.9)(transferTimeMSec) as 90th,
  quantile(0.95)(transferTimeMSec) as 95th,
  quantile(0.99)(transferTimeMSec) as 99th
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Edge TransferTime; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Edge TransferTime

panels.description: The time in milliseconds from when the edge server receives the last byte of the request to when it sends the first bytes of the response.

targets.rawSql:

  quantile(0.25)(turnAroundTimeMSec) as 25th,
  quantile(0.5)(turnAroundTimeMSec) as 50th,

  quantile(0.9)(turnAroundTimeMSec) as 90th,

  AND $__conditionalAll( transferTimeMSec >= ${transferTimeMSec_percentile}, ${transferTimeMSec_percentile})
